events.description: Al-Quds al-'Arabi publishes the faxed World Islamic Front fatwa declaring the killing of Americans and allies, civilian and military, an individual duty.
Al-Quds al-'Arabi publishes the World Islamic Front's fatwa declaring that killing Americans and their allies is an individual duty, signed by Bin Ladin, Zawahiri, Taha, Mir Hamzah and Fazlul Rahman.
The statement is faxed to Al-Quds al-'Arabi bearing the five signatures.

key_claims: Bin Ladin, Zawahiri, Taha, Mir Hamzah and Fazlul Rahman jointly signed a fatwa under the World Islamic Front banner.
The fatwa declares killing Americans and their allies, civilian and military, an individual duty for every Muslim.
It justifies this by US troops in the Arabian Peninsula, the Iraq blockade, and support for Israel.
The statement was faxed to Al-Quds al-'Arabi in London, which published it on 23 Feb 1998.
